driver: STM32N6 system window watchdog (WWDG) low-level (LL) driver as delivered by ST (STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 60 (WWDG) + memory map p.181
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.60 WWDG register interface + memory map p.181 (WWDG secure base 0x50002C00)
target.safety_allocation: NOT_PROVIDED: no owner safety scope recorded for the WWDG campaign work orders

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure WWDG (stm32n6xx.h)

Activate the watchdog (WWDG_CR.WDGA, set-only) and query the activation; write and read the counter (WWDG_CR.T); set and read the timer base prescaler (WWDG_CFR.WDGTB) and the window value (WWDG_CFR.W)
Enable and query the early wake-up interrupt (WWDG_CFR.EWI, set-only); query and clear the early wake-up flag (WWDG_SR.EWIF)
Out of scope: HAL API, the watchdog reset generation and the early wake-up interrupt handler, the WWDG bus clock enable (RCC)

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15), reused for the feature 015 benchmark set (2026-10-25) and the feature 014 operation-24 campaign (2026-10-27)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 014 operation-24 campaign (owner 2026-10-27: new ST LL drivers RNG, LPTIM, WWDG): ST's existing STM32CubeN6 WWDG LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects WWDG_S at 0x50002C00).

scope.note: activation, counter, timer base prescaler, window, early wake-up interrupt enable and flag
